sources.title: E-GRPO: High Entropy Steps Drive Effective Reinforcement Learning
sources.snippet: We observe that the high entropy steps enable more efficient and effective exploration while the low entropy steps result in undistinguished roll-outs. To this end, we propose E-GRPO, an entropy aware Group Relative Policy Optimization to increase the entropy of SDE sampling steps.
